label: Neufchâtel
note: The Norman cheese with a white mould rind; the American cream cheese called Neufchâtel is a different, unripened cheese (see Cream cheese)

about.text: A soft, slightly crumbly cheese from Neufchâtel-en-Bray in Normandy with a white bloomy rind, saltier and sharper than Camembert.
